item.description: Seth MacFarlane is best known for creating Family Guy and American Dad! He's also an accomplished singer. Now, he's out with a new record of Muppets songs.

item.description: As Xi Jinping heads to the White House, polls show Americans feeling their best days are behind them. But what does America look like from China?

item.title: Understanding Jensen Huang's AI optimism and how it influences President Trump
item.description: The Nvidia CEO is a relentless AI optimist with the president's ear. Stephen Witt, author of The Thinking Machine, tells NPR's Juana Summers how their relationship could shape the future of AI.

item.title: How to understand Trump's national security defense in his press ban
item.description: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Andrew Weissmann, a legal analyst and former federal prosecutor, about the Trump administration's rationale for banning three news outlets from the White House.

item.title: What painter Sliman Mansour told NPR about Palestinian rights and art before he died
item.description: Born a year before Israel's creation, Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour spent his life painting the faces and landscapes of Israeli occupation. He died in August aged 79, and was buried in the occupied West Bank.
